$schema_doc: Each Instagram single-image post is one object. The schedule-tweets skill picks up the first post with status='pending' and posts it to Instagram with the attached image. Status flow: 'pending' (queued) -> 'posting' (mid-flight) -> 'posted' (live) -> 'failed'. IG single-image constraints: caption up to 2,200 chars, up to 30 hashtags total (counted across caption + comments per IG's policy), one image per post (single-image format; carousel and reels are separate queues). image_id and image_path are REQUIRED; IG posts cannot be text-only. The hashtags array is stored separately so it can be appended to the caption or posted as the first comment depending on hashtag_placement. Aspect ratio defaults to 1:1 (square); 4:5 portrait is also feed-eligible. The source_post field optionally links to a tweet/thread/yt-post id when the IG post is a cross-platform repurpose. likes and comments are populated when results are captured (default 7 days post-posting).

$post_schema.caption: <full caption text, up to 2,200 chars; hook on first line>
$post_schema.hook: <first line / sentence of caption, used for filtering/sorting>
$post_schema.image_id: <8-char hex UUID, matches a file in schedule-tweets/images/>
$post_schema.source_post: <optional: tweet hook, thread id, yt-post id if cross-posted from another channel>
